dialogue.line: - so the research I was talking about, some weird, swamp-dwelling species..
Really? Tell me about it hun!
Some strange fish, almost oarfish-like..
- wait, hold on, I have notes on it somewh-
GAH! MY PAPERS!
I got it I got it!
Some time later...
Huff.. Sorry hun, couldn't - huff.. find it..
Gah, it's fine.. I'll just reprin-
- huh.. That bus line, haven't seen it around before..
Me either, weird.
Reckon we should see who's coming, eh?
I mean..
Sure, not like there's shitelse to do here.. let's go!
Hey! Nice to meet you folk.
Sorry, hehe.. he's boyfriend, and I'm Girlfriend!
Boyfriend n' Girlfriend, she says..
I'm Katelyn, and this is Kai, nice to meet you guys!
(holds out microphone)
Eh? You wanna sing?
Not much of a singer, sorry, Katelyn'll gladly do one though!
I will?????
Wanna start us off?
Oh.. so I guess I don't mind..
